about: True parameters of the mmm_drift extension dataset in data/synthetic/, written by scripts/make_synthetic.py from src/mktstats/synth/. Do not edit by hand.
description: Weekly sales = intercept + trend + yearly seasonality + price and holiday effects + sum of channel contributions + Normal noise; channel contribution = B_c * m_c(t) * logistic(lam_c * normalized_geometric_adstock(spend_c) / max(spend_c)). Only social wears out: m_social(t) falls smoothly from about 1 to about 0.4 (logistic in t); the other channels have m_c(t) = 1.
adstock: GeometricAdstock(l_max=8, normalize=True), zero spend before the first week
saturation: LogisticSaturation: beta * (1 - exp(-lam x)) / (1 + exp(-lam x))
units: adstock_alpha and saturation_lam are scale-free (lam applies to adstocked spend / channel_scale, the channel's maximum weekly spend); saturation_beta_sales_units is B_c in dollars per week at m_c(t) = 1; spend, contribution and sales are dollars.
roas_definition: Window definition: ROAS_c(W) = sum over the weeks in W of the channel's noiseless contribution (multiplier included) / its spend in those weeks; carry-in from earlier spend counts, carry-out after the window does not. Computed from the contributions as written to mmm_drift_latent.csv (rounded to cents). roas_last_quarter_counterfactual is pymc-marketing's contribution_over_spend definition: spend zeroed in the window, carry-in kept, the change in contribution summed from the window's first week to the end of the data, over the window's spend.

multiplier.acts_on: the week the effect lands (after adstock and saturation), as pymc-marketing's time_varying_media multiplier
multiplier.relative_path: multiplier_rel_<c> = m_c(t) / mean over all weeks of m_c(t): the quantity pymc-marketing's SoftPlusHSGP multiplier estimates (it is normalized to mean 1 over the fitted weeks)
multiplier.drift_ratio: mean of m_c over the last quarter / mean over the first year (the same for m_c and its relative path)

fatigue.form: m(t) = 1 - (1 - end) / (1 + exp(-(t - mid) / width)), t = 0 .. n_weeks - 1

spend_process.tv: flights on 4-8 weeks, off 3-8; 60000 x Uniform(0.7, 1.3) when on
spend_process.search: 20000 x d_t x LogNormal(0, 0.12); d_t = (intercept + trend_t + seasonality_t) / intercept (follows demand)
spend_process.social: 10000 x LogNormal(0, 0.3), x 2.5 in a four-week push starting every 13 weeks (jitter -2..+2)

baseline.price_process: AR(1) around 1 with coefficient 0.7 and sd 0.012; ten promotion weeks 4 to 10% lower; rounded to 4 decimals
baseline.holiday_rule: weeks containing Black Friday, December 18 or December 24

economics.rule: cut a channel's budget next quarter if P(current-quarter ROAS < break-even) >= 0.9; keep if P(> break-even) >= 0.9; otherwise run a lift test first

social.net_return_definition: spend x (gross_margin x ROAS - 1): the margin on the sales the spend produced, net of the spend

lift_tests.definition: One randomized geo test on social, scaled to the national level (the weekly spend series is unchanged): weekly spend raised from x (mean social spend over the 26 weeks before the test, rounded to $100) to x + delta_x (delta_x = 0.3 x, rounded to $100) for test_weeks weeks ending in the week `date`. true_delta_y = B_social x mean of m_social over the test weeks x [s((x + delta_x) / S) - s(x / S)] (steady state: the saturation curve only, as add_lift_test_measurements models it, times the multiplier as pymc-marketing's time-varying lift test does at `date`); delta_y = true_delta_y + Normal(0, sigma), sigma = 8% of the true lift (Module 9's relative error).

tolerances.sampler: nutpie, 2 chains on 2 cores, draws = tune = 300 (QUICK) and 1000 (FULL), target_accept 0.98, random_seed 2037, Module 8's spend-share priors

checks.checkpoint_1: window_roas on the latent contributions equals roas, roas_first_year and roas_last_quarter to a relative 1e-9
checks.static_model: window ROAS over all weeks equals contribution_over_spend to 1e-8; social's last-quarter HDI lies above roas_last_quarter
checks.checkpoint_2: social's residual-spend correlation falls most from the first year to the last and ends below -0.3
checks.checkpoint_4: coverage of the true relative path: social >= 0.5, others >= 0.9
checks.drifting_model: social's drift-ratio HDI lies below 1; the others' contain 1
checks.checkpoint_5: social: Prophet-baseline mean below own-baseline mean, its HDI excludes roas, the own-baseline HDI covers it
checks.decision: cut if P(last-quarter ROAS < break-even) >= 0.9 under the drifting model

measured_2026_10_10.divergences: 0 in every fit, QUICK and FULL, stretch fits included
